name: cost_alloc
summary: the one dollar split shared by cost_day, cost_unit, cost_unit_tag. Grain: one row per (billing row, part): a warehouse DBU row splits into query parts (one per distinct query_tags set) + warehouse_idle/warehouse_unsplit; every other row is one part. Materialized ephemeral in schema (ephemeral).

name: cost_unit
summary: priced dollars per allocation unit; unit_id = md5(workspace|compute_kind|compute_id|work_kind|work_id|usage_unit|sorted custom_tags). Grain: one row per (window_days, unit_id). Materialized table in schema tags.

name: window_days
summary: grain key of cost_unit: lookback window label (7/30/90; 0 = whole snapshot)

name: unit_id
summary: grain key of cost_unit: md5 hash identifying an allocation unit, stable across windows

name: cost_unit_tag
summary: real tag values per cost_unit at compute/work/workspace level; no untagged rows. Grain: one row per (window_days, unit_id, level, tag_key, tag_value). Materialized table in schema tags.

name: window_days
summary: grain key of cost_unit_tag: lookback window label (7/30/90; 0 = whole snapshot)

name: unit_id
summary: grain key of cost_unit_tag: md5 hash identifying an allocation unit, stable across windows

name: level
summary: grain key of cost_unit_tag: compute | work | workspace

name: tag_key
summary: grain key of cost_unit_tag: normalised key (lower, spaces/_/- removed; dbt/macros/norm_tag_key.sql)

name: cost_day
summary: every billed dollar per day with its winning tag signature (work over compute). Grain: one row per (usage_date, workspace_id, cloud, sku_name, billing_origin_product, usage_unit, product flags, sig_id). Materialized table in schema tags.

name: cost_reconciliation

name: window_days
summary: grain key of cost_reconciliation: lookback window label (7/30/90; 0 = whole snapshot)

name: perf_unit

name: unit_id
summary: grain key of perf_unit: md5 hash identifying an allocation unit, stable across windows

summary: grain key of perf_unit_tag: lookback window label (7/30/90; 0 = whole snapshot)
